items.text: There was once. <break time="0.8s" /> A poor shoemaker. <break time="0.8s" /> He worked hard. <break time="0.8s" /> But he became very poor. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon he had leather. <break time="0.8s" /> For only one pair of shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> In the evening he cut the leather. <break time="0.8s" /> For the shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> I will finish the shoes in the morning. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he said a prayer. <break time="0.8s" /> And went to sleep. <break time="0.8s" /> In the morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The shoes were on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> They were all done. <break time="0.8s" /> And every stitch was perfect.

옛날 옛적에. <break time="0.8s" /> 가난한 구두장이가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 열심히 일했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그는 아주 가난해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 그에게는 가죽이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두 딱 한 켤레를 만들 만큼만. <break time="0.8s" /> 저녁에 그는 가죽을 잘랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두를 만들려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 아침에 구두를 다 만들어야지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그는 기도를 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 잠이 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아침에 보니. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두가 탁자 위에 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두는 다 만들어져 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 바늘땀 하나하나가 완벽했다.
